verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents a first-party `wezterm cli` subcommand that drives a running GUI or multiplexer instance to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes, and it supports command-line config overrides. That gives real programmatic control over the core windowing surface. Nothing shows this reaches parity with the UI: scrollback search, quick select, copy mode and other UI features have no documented programmatic equivalent, and no OpenAPI or similar API surface was found. missing for 10: evidence of full UI-to-API parity, programmatic access to search/quick-select/copy-mode and other UI actions, a documented comprehensive API reference, independent corroboration of automation coverage
